metadata.title: Upside-Down Polaroid Portrait on Textured Pastel

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, square-format photograph oriented upside-down, featuring a female figure with long hair and dark makeup, set against a wide, textured dusty-pink border. The subject has dark, calligraphic-style markings on her chest and neck.
coreVisualRelationships: Square inset centered within a larger rectangular field
Upside-down orientation of the subject relative to the frame
Contrast between the warm skin tones and the cool, desaturated pink border
Integration of dark, fluid graphic markings directly onto the photographic subject
coreInvariants: Square central frame with thin border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is contained within a central square occupying approximately 40% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy hair and the calligraphic markings on the chest serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark hair at the bottom of the square, moves upward to the face, and then to the graphic markings on the neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the wide, monochromatic pink border surrounding the central image.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black (hair, makeup, and chest markings)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the skin and the black graphic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weights mimicking ink on skin
Abstracted forms that blend with body contours
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are treated as body art rather than legible text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: None; the graphic lettering stands alone as a visual element.

candidateDirections.reason: To maintain the organic, painted-on-skin appearance.
To preserve the visual weight without requiring literal readability.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a wide, dusty pink background with a subtle paper texture. In the center, place a square photograph of a woman with long dark hair and dark makeup, oriented upside-down. The photo should have a slight film grain and a thin off-white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply black, hand-painted calligraphic markings onto the neck and chest area of the subject, following the contours of the body.

verificationChecks: Is the pink border sufficiently wide and textured?
Do the markings on the chest look like hand-applied ink?
Is the overall mood moody and desaturated?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the square inset is perfectly centered.
Check that the black markings do not look like a digital font overlay.
Verify the texture is consistent across the pink border.
Confirm the upside-down orientation is preserved.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central square photo + upside-down orientation + wide textured pastel border + integrated body-art graphics.
